recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless future regeneration reintroduces a stale component row for the oxygen saturation profile.
issue_request: FHIR-29115 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for the R4 observation-oxygensat profile. It asked to clarify the confusing component.value[x] presentation where polymorphic types appeared alongside UCUM vital-signs binding and Quantity-only requirement language.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-29115 was found. The effective application appears to have happened through later vital-signs work: FHIR-46418 reorganized the profiles, FHIR-47136 removed MustSupport from non-blood-pressure components and reorganized component profiling, and FHIR-44721/FHIR-47136 changed Observation.component.valueQuantity to the all-UCUM value set.
additional_context: The original Zulip thread confirms the R4 component.value[x] type-list versus UCUM/Quantity contradiction. The current oxygen saturation profile is in build scope through the active Observation resource and the Observation Vital Signs IG. Current source has no oxygen-saturation-specific Observation.component differential; the base vital-signs component.value[x] is unbound, and only its valueQuantity slice has a preferred all-UCUM binding.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current source allows arbitrary components, does not bind non-Quantity component values, and limits component Quantity terminology guidance to a preferred all-UCUM binding.
